basic_details.job_title: DLSA Ananthapuramu Driver Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One post of Driver (On Hire Basis) is open at the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), Ananthapuramu, for driving and operational use of its Multi Utility Vehicle (MUV). Applications in the prescribed format must be sent by Registered Post or Speed Post to the Chairman-cum-Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, Nyaya Seva Sadan, District Court Compound, Ananthapuramu, and must reach by 05.00 PM on 15 December 2026 (last date for receipt). The vacancy was announced through Notification No.01/DLSA/ATP/2026 dated 16 November 2026.

qualification.details: The notice offers one post of Driver (On Hire Basis), with these requirements: | Qualification: 10th Class and having Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) Driving License. Preference: Priority will be given to candidates who worked in the Court/ Legal Services Authority earlier. Age limit: Must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 44 years as on 01-09-2026, subject to the applicable rules. Age relaxation: The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Backward Classes (BC) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS); it is relaxable by 10 years for Ex-Servicemen as applicable under rules in force. Health: The candidate must be of sound health, active habits and free from any bodily defect or infirmity rendering him/her unfit for the service. Character: The candidate's character and antecedents must be such as would not disqualify for the service. Pay: Rs.800/- per working day, subject to a maximum ceiling of Rs.23,780/- per month. | The following persons are not eligible for appointment: anyone dismissed from State or Central Government service or from the service of a Central or State Government undertaking, and anyone convicted by a Court of Law for an offence involving moral turpitude. For the full wording of each condition, candidates can refer to the official notification.

selection_process: Selection will be through an Interview (Viva Voce) and a Driving test. The date

time and venue of the interview and of the driving test will be filled in by the office on the call letter. The Chairman-cum-Principal District Judge reserves the right to shortlist applications as per the rules and instructions issued by the A.P. State Legal Services Authority
important_instructions: The Driver will be engaged on hire basis, purely temporary in nature, and the engagement will not confer any right for future employment. Applications received without proper attestation and sufficient information will be rejected. Applications received after the due date, not in the prescribed format or without the requisite documents will not be accepted. No T.A/D.A. will be paid to the candidates. Candidates bringing any influence of any kind will be summarily disqualified and are liable for prosecution as per law. No information will be sent to unsuccessful candidates, and merely applying gives no right to be considered for appointment. The authority reserves the right to postpone or cancel the notification at any stage without assigning any reason, as per the directions of the A.P. State Legal Services Authority.

content_sections.heading: About DLSA Ananthapuramu
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Ananthapuramu functions from Nyaya Seva Sadan in the District Court Compound, Ananthapuramu, Andhra Pradesh, headed by the Chairman-cum-Principal District Judge. This recruitment follows Lr.ROC.No.169-E1/APSLSA/Estt/2026 dated 14 October 2026 of the A.P. State Legal Services Authority, Amaravati. The Driver will be engaged for driving and operational use of the authority's Multi Utility Vehicle.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be filled only in the prescribed proforma enclosed with the notification and sent with its enclosures to this address: The Chairman-cum-Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, Nyaya Seva Sadan, District Court Compound, Ananthapuramu. Fill in the prescribed application form enclosed with Notification No.01/DLSA/ATP/2026 (applications in any other format are not accepted). Affix a latest passport size photo attested by a Gazetted Officer on the application form. Fill in serial numbers 1 to 5 of the enclosed call letter (name, father's/husband's name, date of birth and age as on 01.09.2026, Aadhaar number, category) and affix a recent passport size colour photo attested by a Gazetted Officer. Attach the attested documents listed under Enclosures, including a self-addressed envelope stamped worth Rs.75/-. Indicate your Local/Non-Local status in respect of Judicial Districts. Send the application by Registered Post or Speed Post only so that it reaches the above address by 05.00 PM on 15 December 2026. Applications submitted in person shall not be accepted. The office is not responsible for postal delay, delay caused by courier or any other delay in delivery.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice offers one post of Driver (On Hire Basis), with these requirements: Qualification: 10th Class and having Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) Driving License. Preference: Priority will be given to candidates who worked in the Court/ Legal Services Authority earlier. Age limit: Must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 44 years as on 01-09-2026, subject to the applicable rules. Age relaxation: The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Backward Classes (BC) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS); it is relaxable by 10 years for Ex-Servicemen as applicable under rules in force. Health: The candidate must be of sound health, active habits and free from any bodily defect or infirmity rendering him/her unfit for the service. Character: The candidate's character and antecedents must be such as would not disqualify for the service. Pay: Rs.800/- per working day, subject to a maximum ceiling of Rs.23,780/- per month. The following persons are not eligible for appointment: anyone dismissed from State or Central Government service or from the service of a Central or State Government undertaking, and anyone convicted by a Court of Law for an offence involving moral turpitude. For the full wording of each condition, candidates can refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Photostat copies of academic and technical qualifications, such as pass certificates, certificate evidencing date of birth, community certificate issued by the Competent Authority and experience certificate if any, duly attested by a Gazetted Officer of State or Central Government. Valid Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) driving license and any other certificate to prove professional skills. No-Objection Certificate from Employer (only if employed anywhere). Copy of the caste certificate (OC/BC/SC/ST with sub-group) and, for Ex-Servicemen, copies of relevant certificates, as asked in the application form. A self-addressed envelope, duly stamped worth Rs.75/-, for speed post with acknowledgment due. Original certificates must be produced for verification on the day informed by the District Legal Services Authority, Ananthapuramu; a candidate who fails to produce any of the required certificates will have the candidature summarily rejected. The application form also asks for the Employment Exchange Registration Number with date and place, mobile number, other qualifications and previous experience, if any.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be through an Interview (Viva Voce) and a Driving test. The date, time and venue of the interview and of the driving test will be filled in by the office on the call letter. The Chairman-cum-Principal District Judge reserves the right to shortlist applications as per the rules and instructions issued by the A.P. State Legal Services Authority, Amaravati.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Ananthapuramu Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Driver (On Hire Basis) under Notification No.01/DLSA/ATP/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the DLSA office by 05.00 PM on 15 December 2026; applications received later will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates need 10th Class and a Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) Driving License.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed 18 years and must not have completed 44 years as on 01-09-2026, subject to the applicable rules.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: SC, ST, BC and EWS candidates get 5 years' relaxation in the upper age limit, and Ex-Servicemen get up to 10 years as applicable under rules in force.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the DLSA Ananthapuramu Driver?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.800/- per working day, subject to a maximum ceiling of Rs.23,780/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application form with attested enclosures to the Chairman-cum-Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, Nyaya Seva Sadan, District Court Compound, Ananthapuramu by Registered Post or Speed Post only.

faq.question: Q8. Can I submit the application in person?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that applications submitted in person shall not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through an Interview (Viva Voce) and a Driving test.

faq.question: Q10. Is the DLSA Ananthapuramu Driver job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on hire basis, purely temporary in nature, and does not confer any right for future employment.
